name: spec-prove-v4-internal
description: Internal Uniswap v4 falsification-and-repair workflow: submit a bounded JSON transaction trace. The trusted host executes it against pinned v4 PoolManager, checks Lean evidence, obtains independent host-funded LLM judgment, materializes a bounded spec or contract repair proposal, replays it, and runs a second review. Score covers verified R2/R3 evidence only after the contract-repair path passes; maximum 2. No participant code, external-chain deployment, or creator approval.
